families.name: Synthetic CSC University Route
pages: overview
Synthetic CSC University Route is awarded by Synthetic CSC Council for study in CN. The 2027 intake offers the Synthetic CSC Graduate Course at masters level. Official scholarship overview.
funding
Funding benefits: tuition is fully covered and a monthly stipend is provided.
eligibility
Eligibility: applicants must hold a bachelor's degree as an academic requirement.
dates
Application deadline 2027-05-15. Submit the application before the deadline.
apply
The official application process uses the Online Application route. Apply online at https://csc-fixture.test/apply.
documents
Required documents: Passport is required and one certified copy must be submitted.
